verdict.rationale: Adyen exposes webhooks for status changes, detailed refusal-reason codes, an idempotency-key API, and an official MCP server that lets LLM agents interact via natural language—these are solid building blocks for an agent to detect failed payments and act. However, there is no evidence of built-in retry scheduling or dunning-outreach orchestration; that logic would have to be custom-built on top of the API/webhooks/MCP, and community feedback flags Adyen's integration as more 'bare metal' and complex than turnkey competitors.
